# Tests allowed over 30 s in CI's race jobs (scripts/test-times.py): one a
# line, the package as go test prints it, the test, then why after a #.
# Only a test a pull request adds fails its job over 30 s; any other gets a
# warning. So a line here is for a new test slow on purpose, or silences
# the warning of an existing one: all the lines below are of the latter.
# A job's summary lists the tests of this file now under 30 s, whose lines
# can go.
#
# These wait in real time, by design, for a torrent's start and its pieces'
# timeouts: a 2026-11-07 run of the whole suite took 30.8 to 124.5 s each.
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestATorrentWhoseFirstBytesComeSlowlyPlaysAtItsFirstPlay # a 40 s engine start scales its waits up to 140 s
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestATorrentTooSlowForThePlayIsToldToTryLater # the play's longest wait, 64 s
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestAPlayJoiningASlowTorrentsAnalysisWaitsAsLongAsAlone # each play's longest wait, 64 s
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestATorrentWhosePeerHoldsItsPiecesPlaysOnceItSends # the engine's start and a piece's wait
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestATorrentWhosePiecesKeepComingPlaysAtItsFirstPlay # pieces for about 55 s past a 35 s first wait
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestATorrentWhoseProxyFreezesAtItsFirstPlayPlaysOnceItAnswers # a proxy frozen for 40 s
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestPlaysThatGaveUpLeaveNoGoroutineBehind # an analysis waiting a piece's wait twice
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestATorrentPlayAnswersOnceItsStartAndAPiecesWaitPassed # the start and a piece's wait
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/playback TestASubtitleTrackOfAStalledTorrentIsReadOnceItSends # a read stalled over a swarm sending nothing
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/playback TestAPictureTrackOfAStalledTorrentIsReadOnceItSends # a read stalled over a swarm sending nothing
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/playback TestSubtitlesOfASlowTorrentAreLocatedOnceItSends # an index read too slow for its wait
#
# These make, convert or decode video and audio with FFmpeg, record in real
# time, or build large data on purpose: CI's first run with this check,
# 42417985281, took 30.4 to 44.0 s each under the race detector.
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestShareBluRaysPlayCopied # plays three Blu-ray discs (folder, ISO, UDF) through FFmpeg from a WebDAV share, whole and from a seek
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestARecordingTakingTheViewersTunerAnswers503 # FFmpeg converts a live 5.1 channel until a recording takes its tuner, waited for up to 2 min
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestLocalEpisodesShareTheirCredits # makes six episodes' audio with FFmpeg and finds their shared 60 s credits in it
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestProgrammeIsRecordedAndPlays # records a live stream with FFmpeg for at least 30 s of real time, then plays the file
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/jellyfin TestLocalMPEGTSFilesPlayConvertedUntilTheirKeyframesAreRead # encodes a 750 s MPEG-TS file with FFmpeg, plays it converted, then copied
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/thumbnails TestThumbnailsDuringThePlay # encodes a long video with FFmpeg and makes thumbnails over 10 minutes of play
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/thumbnails TestImagesFollowTheKeyframesTimes # decodes HEVC keyframes with FFmpeg, once for each read order and budget
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/iptv TestLargeLineupsStayFast # a line-up of 5,400 entries under the race detector (54,000 without), on purpose: its time bounds are the test
github.com/moodiness/polyfin/internal/library TestTheTitlesKeptForSmartListsStayWithinTheirBound # 2,000-title catalogs read for 3 lists and 5 users; 4.8 s without the race detector, slow only under it and its package's 223 parallel tests: for #999
